name: Veyra
works_with: Windows 11 x64 with DirectX 12, on NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards
short: A Windows video player and capture tool that sharpens video, capture card feeds and game streams on your graphics card in real time.
what: Veyra runs local video, images, capture cards, PS5 Remote Play, PC streaming through Sunshine, experimental Xbox streaming and screen capture through one GPU pipeline. It can add super resolution, denoising, HDR, anti-aliasing and frame generation, either from a simple list or a node editor. You can also record, take screenshots and export enhanced video to MP4 or MKV.
who: Windows gamers and video fans with a recent NVIDIA or AMD card who want to upscale or smooth what they watch or capture. Skip it on Mac, Linux or older Windows, or without a capable GPU.
needs: An NVIDIA or AMD graphics card, with its drivers installed
Capture card drivers, if you use a capture card
For PC streaming: Sunshine, installed and set up yourself

steps.title: Download the right package
steps.text: From the latest release on GitHub, get `Veyra-2.1.6-NVIDIA-win64-portable.zip` or `Veyra-2.1.6-AMD-win64-portable.zip`, to match your graphics card. You need only one.

steps.title: Extract and run
steps.text: Extract it with Windows or 7-Zip into a new folder you can write to, then run `veyra_qml_ui.exe`.

steps.title: Start with effects off
steps.text: Check that picture and sound work, then turn effects on one at a time. High resolution, layered denoising and frame generation all need more GPU memory.

steps.title: Pick a source
steps.text: Home offers files, capture card, PS5, PC, Xbox and screen capture. You can also drop files into the window.

steps.title: Turn on effects
steps.text: In Professional, choose List and switch on super resolution, denoising or RTX Video HDR. Export only works from List mode.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Drop a video file into the window, open Professional, choose List and switch on super resolution.

watch: Upgrading: extract into a new folder. Don't overwrite a new install with an old `veyra.ini`, a whole `runtime_local` folder or mixed DLLs.
PS5 pairing has you open a third-party site, PSNTools, to look up your Account ID.
Xbox streaming is unofficial and experimental, and account, service and console limits apply.
The README lists unverified cases: other overlay tools, long Xbox sessions, and some RTX 30/40 and AMD setups.
When you report a problem you share logs and crash dumps. The README asks you to check them for private data first.
The ANR runtime is not included, because its upstream does not allow redistribution during its beta.
